A '''sound emitter''' was a piece of sonic technology. They were used to discharge bursts from [[Sonic weapon/Legends|sonic weapons]] such as [[Pacnorval Defense Systems, Limited]]'s [[Sd-77 sonic pistol]] and [[Sg-82 sonic rifle]]. The sound emitter, in conjunction with weapon's [[sonic projector]] controlled the precise width of the sonic cone.<ref name="EGWT" /> The [[Ovoni]] employed sonic emitters that they could use to summon creatures.<ref name="Hidden">''[[Purge – The Hidden Blade]]''</ref>
